runtime_contract: getStreams(tmdbId, mediaType, season, episode) plus global SCRAPER_SETTINGS

manifest_platform_filtering.consequence: Do not rely on manifest platform fields to hide an unsafe provider from NuvioTV; the provider output itself must be strict-media safe or globally disabled.

semantic_changes_reviewed: parsing-error recovery now probes actual network MIME rather than blindly forcing HLS
MIME probe reuses sanitized selected-stream playback headers and default User-Agent fallback
subtitle charset, SDH stripping and sidecar subtitle behavior
player initialization/error recovery and bundled player library changes
server/account/catalog/home/search changes outside provider runtime contract

notes: NuvioTV provider compatibility is a distinct runtime family from Nuvio Mobile and Nuvio Desktop.
The source_ref is the exact official NuvioTV commit most recently source-audited against this contract and is re-proven by Niakvio native-client tests before publication.
The 2026-08-16 audit found no changes under PluginRuntime/PluginManager/StreamRepository/AddonApi/plugin model contract paths between the previous baseline and source_ref.

The current parsing-error fallback probes the selected URL with its playback headers; this is compatible with providers requiring Referer/Origin/User-Agent and removes the former unconditional HLS assumption.
NuvioTV currently parses supportedPlatforms/disabledPlatforms in the manifest model but its PluginManager does not apply those fields when building enabled scrapers.
A zero-stream result is not by itself proof of incompatibility.
Providers blocked on every Mobile/Desktop runtime but still enabled in the shared manifest must sanitize all NuvioTV-returned URLs against real media payloads.
Promoted direct-media wrappers require strict HLS, DASH or real container evidence.
